author: Jennifer Kilgore Beasley
text: ￼ so what do you do if the Freestyle shows you have an urgent loan and you don’t correct. My Dr uses the information in my phone, so if I don’t correct, then that low will not fix itself.

author: Patrick Xjr
text:
Good morning 
If it was working fine, it is strange this values now.
Two assumptions:
A shock on the sensor, or tape not adhesive anymore.
Second possibility, some blood, polluting the sensor. Have you got some blood going out from sensor?

First thing to do:
You measure with finger test, then you phone to Abbott. With such figures you will have a first conversation with technical , then when such low values, you will speak with a nurse about how you feel, normally they replace the sensor…
